as_told.title: Jessica Utts review of CIA remote viewing data

plain: Stargate was a US government programme that studied remote viewing, the claimed ability to describe faraway places using only the mind. A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says a well-known statistician named Jessica Utts, whom he calls a president of the American Statistical Association, studied the released Stargate records, came in a skeptic, and came out thinking there was something real there. In some tellings he calls it a combined study of the data from the 1990s, done alongside a skeptic named Ray Hyman, which if right would mean the mind can gather information in ways science can't explain.
